cuda_host_replay.note: CUDA executable, host-only saved-pool replay: no CUDA context or GPU kernels.

limitations: Top-200 exported-candidate audit and saved-pool replay, not full search-space coverage. Fixed skew validation after a 16k-angle grid search; no new translation optimization or actual test sieving. Uniform-root lattice model omits actual acceptance policy and execution costs. Exact size means the existing bounded local integer-translation search, not a proven global optimum. Lower finalists can still be lost. Defaults and pipeline settings unchanged; host implementation remains the reference for GPU migration.
